title: lyonia ovalifolia var. doyonensis
intro: Lyonia ovalifolia var. doyonensis, commonly known as Doyon's Lyonia, is a plant species belonging to the heath family (Ericaceae). The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities. Its therapeutic actions are believed to be due to its bioactive constituents, which include triterpenoids and flavonoids, that may help alleviate conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. Additionally, the plant's bioactive compounds may contribute to its potential as an antiviral and antifungal agent.
